chapter.verse: Note khatpeuh, a dang khat' tungah na lungkim loh uh ciangin mi siangthote zuan lo-in thutanglo mite' mai-ah zum kitun ngamzaw na hi uh hiam?
Ahihkeileh mi siangthote pen leitung thu a khen dingte cih thei lo na hi uh hiam? Note pen leitung thu a khen ding kimlai buaina neunote a khen dingin cinglah mawk hilo na hi uh hiam?
Eite pen vanmite' thu nangawn a khen ding i hihlam thei lo na hi uh hiam? Tua ci lehang, leitung nuntakvai thute cihna vet om lo hi.
Tua hi a, leitung nuntakvai buainate na neih uhleh bang hangin pawlpi sunga minhoih neilote' mai-ah tua thute tun na hi uh hiam?
Na maizum nadingun hih bang hong gen ka hi hi. Note' lakah sanggamte kikal buainate a khensiang zo ding zah-a pil om lo cih bang hithei zawzen ding ahi hiam?
Sanggam khatlekhat thu kinei-in thu-umlo mite' mai na kitun tazen uh hi.
Khatlekhat zum na kitut himhim uh a guallel na hi khinta uh hi. Hong kikhialhna thuakzaw mai-in hong kikhemna thuakzaw mai hohleh uhcin hilo ahi hiam?
No ngiat a khial a khem na hizaw uh a, na sanggamte nangawn uh na map kei uh hi.

Thutanglo mite in Pasian' kumpigam luah lo ding uh ahihlam thei lo na hi uh hiam? Theikhialkha kei un: nulepa vai a takhialte, milim biate, angkawmte, neih kibang mawhpih a thuakte, nulepa nam nih a mawhpihte,
gutate, duhhop huaihamte, zukhamte, mi kosiate leh mikhemte in Pasian' kumpigam luah lo ding uh hi.
Note kimkhat tua dan na hi uh hi. Ahi zongin Topa Jesu Khris' min leh i Pasian' Kha Siangtho tungtawnin note hong kisilsiangin hong kisiansuah a, diksakna hong kipia ahi hi.
“Na khempeuh hihtheih nading thu ka nei hi,” i cih hangin na khempeuh kimanna nei kimlo hi. “Na khempeuh hihtheih nading thu ka nei hi,” ka cih hangin kuamah bangmah in kei hong uk zolo ding hi.

“An pen gilpi' ading, gilpi pen an' ading” himah a, ahi zongin Pasian in hihte gel a nihin susia ding hi. Pumpi pen nulepa tatkhialhna' ading hilo hi. Pumpi pen Topa' ading hi a, Topa pen pumpi' ading ahi hi.
Pasian in Topa thokiksak a, eite zong ama' vangliatna tawh hong thokiksak ding hi.
Na pumpi uh Khris' pumpi na ahihlam thei lo na hi uh hiam? Khris' pumpi nate lakhia-in numei paktat khat ii pumpi na va suaksak ding ka hi hiam? Tua bang hilo ding hi.
Ahihkeileh zong numei paktat khat tawh a kizom mi pen tua numei tawh sikhat sakhat suak ahihlam thei lo na hi uh hiam? A hang pen, “Tua nihte sikhat sakhat suak ding uh hi,” ci-in kigelh hi.
Tua hi a, Topa tawh a kizom mi pen amah tawh kha khat suak uh hi.
Nulepa tatkhialhna taisan un. Mi khat' bawlkhak mawhna khempeuh pumpi pualama piang hi a, ahi zongin nulepa vai a takhial mi pen ama' pumpi' tungah a khial ahi hi.
Ahihkeileh zong na pumpi uh pen Pasian' kiangpana na ngah uh, note' sunga om Kha Siangtho biakinnpi ahihlam thei lo na hi uh hiam?
Man pia-a hong kileite na hih manun na pumpi uh tawh Pasian minpha pia un.
